task.title: View Patient Information
task.shortdesc: Open a patient's profile to review the information available to your role.

taskbody.prereq: Make sure you are authorized to access the patient's information.

step.cmd: Open the patient record from the available patient-management area.
Select the patient whose information you need to review.
Review the information displayed on the patient profile.

taskbody.result: The selected patient's profile information is displayed.
taskbody.postreq: Close or leave the patient record when you finish reviewing the information, according to your organization's privacy procedures.
